lines.en: I knock on Futaba's door and wait for an answer.

Our last extended hang out session went pretty well apart from a poorly (Or expertly, based on who you ask) timed call from a certain niece of mine...so I'm sure this one will be just as good if not better.
I turn my phone off just to be sure. Sorry, Ami.
: Umm...Sensei?
: Hey. Good guess.
: Well...I already told you you're the only person who ever knocks...
: Oh, sorry. I forgot about the just come in rule.
: Uhh...wait a second, please! I...don't look...normal right now.
: Are you...secretly a werewolf or something?
: Huh? No! Of course not. I just...ummm...hold on.
I hear some scuffling from behind the door as Futaba either attempts to reorganize things or make herself look like less of a werewolf.
I'll find out soon.
: Um...sorry...one more minute, please.
: Okay. But if I count to sixty and don't hear anything again, I'm opening the door.
: No...you're not.
Damn it.
I spend the next minute or two standing beside the door, trying to look as normal as I possibly can while waiting for the person inside.
Needless to say, I do not look very normal.
Okay. What the hell is taking so long?
: Futaba, is everything okay in there? I'm starting to think the werewolf thing might actually be true.
: Ahh! I’m sorry, Sensei...
: You can...come in now...but...again, I'm sorry...
Sorry for what, exactly?
I open the door, unsure of what I'm going to see or why Futaba was so dead set on hiding it from me.
But all I see are two enormous breasts.
: Heeey...
: Sorry you have to see me like this...
: I was looking around for another pair of normal clothes, but everything is in the wash right now, so...
Why is she apologizing after blessing me with such a magnificent sight?
It’s no secret that Futaba’s chest is the largest in the class, but like...come on.
This is just unfair.
How am I supposed to contain myself when she's over here basically spilling out of her pajamas?
: You know there's no need to apologize for just being in your pajamas, right?
: If anything, this shows that you’ve gotten comfortable around me.
: Of course I’m comfortable with you, Sensei...It’s just...
: You know...These pajamas are a little...revealing...
: So...I'm...sorry if I seem embarrassed or anything...
: I mean, this is fifty times better than you seeing me in my pajamas. So I wouldn't worry too much about it.
: I doubt that. I really can't imagine what you wear to sleep being any worse than this.
: Unless it's...one of those really embarrassing one pieces, but...you don't really seem like the type to wear those.
: Oh, no. It's nothing like that.
: I figured. There's no way someone like you would-
: I sleep naked.
: Ah.
: See what I mean?
: Hearing that, don't you feel a little less self-conscious of how revealing your pajamas are? Because, it probably goes without saying, but there's nothing quite as revealing as straight up nudity.
: No.
: No, I guess there's not.
: Futaba?
Uh-oh. I think I might have broken her.
I take a step closer to Futaba and begin snapping my fingers in her face.
: Hey, Futaba. Come back to life now. We don't have all night, you know.
: Naked...
: Sensei...sleeps naked...
: That's totally normal. That's a totally normal thing I know now.
: This is all completely normal. It's fine that he told me that. It's fine that-
Sensing that the snapping isn’t having any effect, I poke one of her cheeks with my index finger and she is immediately shocked back to life.
: Ah! I’m so sorry. I must have zoned out for a second!
: I think I may have...misheard you because it sounded to me like you said you sleep n-
: Ah.
: Futaba, come on.
I poke her cheek a second time.
: I’m so sorry! I have no idea what’s gotten into me!
: I believe the scientific term for it would be arousal.
: A-A-A-A-A-Arousal?! No no no no no! That's not what's happening at all!
: Just because I zoned out...thinking about you with...your...no!
: That's not even remotely close to what's getting into me!
: It's not?
: Of course not! Not even close! Not even almost close! You're so far off that...it's not even funny!
: Oh.
: Then I guess I'm alone in feeling that way.
: You're...what?!
: Did you really expect me to be able to see you in that and not react in this way?
: At the very least, I didn't expect you to come out and just admit it! We're-
: Student and teacher, right? Is that what you were going to say?
: Well, what else am I supposed to say in this position?!
: Here I am being super embarrassed about how I look and...you’re busy thinking weird things and completely ignoring that!
: You were thinking weird things too, though. And you said them out loud well before I did. I'm just following your example.
: It's...different when I say those things about you!
: How, though?
: B...Because...everyone thinks you're really handsome and stuff...and you're probably used to people...fantasizing about you...
: That's...not a thing I've ever realized someone would actually do about me before...
: If...you are actually doing that and...aren't just messing around with me right now...
: How many times do I have to tell you how attractive you are before you start believing me?
: It's not...really that easy to just believe, Sensei...It's a lot more complicated than that.
: I'm sure it is, but I'm going to abuse my position right now and exercise my power as your teacher to command that you listen to me.
: Are you...commanding me to be aroused?!
: No. I am commanding you to accept my arousal without question.
: That's just as bad! In fact...no! That's even worse!
This is fun.
: I miss the old, non-perverted Sensei...This one is weird and...keeps saying weird things that...make me feel weird...
For some strange reason, I'm beginning to think Futaba may be weirded out right now.
Maybe it's for the best if I back off a little?
Being too forward with a girl like her might just wind up scaring her away if I'm not careful.
And after seeing exactly what she has to offer up close and not concealed by a blazer or a button-down, that is not something I am willing to risk.
: Okay, I'll stop. I didn't mean to make you-
: Wait, no! I didn't mean it like that! I’m glad you’re a pervert!
: Wait, what?! That’s not what I meant to say! Why did I say that?!
: I'm just...
: I'm just...really surprised. That’s all...
: I know that boys are generally interested in...breasts and stuff...so I can understand that...reaction from you...
: I know mine are...on the bigger side...
They are not just on the bigger side. They have their own fucking team.
: But that’s just because...I’m a little...overweight...
: So it’s not like they’re...particularly...alluring or anything...
: Ahhh! What am I saying?! And why aren’t you stopping me?!
: Because you're cute, that’s why.
: And I like you the way you are.
: Well...you have weird tastes then...because I don't see myself that way at all...
The two of us stand there in silence for a few seconds as Futaba begins to awkwardly look around the room.
She’s probably nervous that Rin will walk in on this and get the wrong idea or something.
Well...
Would it even count as “getting the wrong idea” here? Because it’s pretty obvious what this conversation has evolved into and Rin would very likely be getting the right idea.
: H-Hey...Can I...ask you something, Sensei?
: Sure. But if it involves how you don't think you're attractive again, I'm probably going to hit you.
: Lightly, of course. But I'll do it.
: I just...
: I just want to know why you've been spending so much time with me lately...
: Do I really need a reason to spend time with you? Can't I just do it because I want to?
: Of course, but...why do you want to?
: I'm...not as pretty as the other girls...or exciting...or even charismatic.
: I just don't get why it seems like...you've been seeking me out when so many better options exist...
: Because I like to, Futaba. It's that simple.
: And I know that’s probably not something I should be saying or doing at my age, but it’s the truth.
Futaba doesn’t answer me right away.
Instead, her eyes navigate to the floor and locate a smile somewhere along the way.
It crawls onto her face like a spider, replacing the crooked frown of uncertainty that stood there just seconds ago.
It’s a sincere smile- one that appears to have melted away all the bits and pieces of uneasiness in her body.
It’s a smile all for me.
I burn it into my retinas so that I may look back on it each time I close my eyes.
: You’re...really cool...
: I'll probably never understand why you keep choosing to hang out with me of all people...but I guess I have to respect your decision when you put it like that...
: And I’m...really sorry for acting strange tonight.
: The conversation just went in...a direction I wasn't prepared for and...I didn't know how to handle it.
: I’d really like it if you...kept coming here, though...
: Because...I really like spending time with you too, Sensei...
: Like...A lot...
: But...as much as I like it...I think you should probably head home before things...head in another direction I'm not really prepared for.
: Do you think they would if I stayed around?
: I'm not sure...
: Lately...nothing really seems to be going the way I expect it to.
: So...I guess anything is really possible as long as I'm with you.
: And that's just a little scary to think about.
: Well, I don't want to scare you. So I'll head out now.
: I’ll definitely be back, though.
: And hopefully, whatever happens next time won't make you think any less of me.
: I'm sure it won't. You openly admitted to...f...fantasizing about me tonight and...that didn't make me think of you any less.
: Cool. Because I'm planning on doing a little more of that as soon as I get home.
: I'm...going to ignore that you just said that and thank you again for stopping by, Sensei.
: Have a good night.
: You too, Futaba...
: See you soon.
Tonight...went well?
Sure, now I’ve got to walk home concealing an erection, but I definitely feel like Futaba and I have somehow strengthened our friendship.
Maybe even to the point where it's starting to morph into something a little more than that.
I hope that whatever cuts its way through the cocoon is as beautiful as she is.
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
